winks.rationale: Spanish 'the light' is the name of the real village La Luz in Otero County, New Mexico.
The word 'Lima' is the exact name of Lima, Ohio (and Lima, NY), a real US city.
The word 'Montevideo' is the exact name of a real city in Chippewa County, Minnesota.
The word 'Castile' is the exact name of the village of Castile in Wyoming County, New York.
Leon (Spanish 'lion') is the exact name of Leon County, Florida (and Leon County, Texas).
The word 'Potosi' is the exact name of a real city in Washington County, Missouri (and Potosi, WI).
The word 'Bogota' is the exact name of the borough of Bogota in Bergen County, New Jersey.
The phrase 'Punta Gorda' is the exact name of a real city in Charlotte County, Florida.
The phrase 'San Carlos' is the exact name of a real city in San Mateo County, California (and San Carlos, AZ).

The surname 'Cabot' is the exact name of the city of Cabot in Lonoke County, Arkansas (and Cabot, VT).
The word 'Florida' is also the exact name of villages/towns named Florida in New York and Massachusetts.
'Martin' is the exact name of multiple US places, e.g. Martin County, KY, and the city of Martin, TN.
The word 'Durango' is the exact name of the real city of Durango, Colorado.
The word 'Phoenix' is also the exact name of villages named Phoenix in New York and Oregon.
The phrase 'Buena Vista' is the exact name of an independent city in Virginia (and Buena Vista, CO/GA).
The word 'Santiago' appears in real US features such as Santiago Peak in the Santa Ana Mountains, California.
